name: fetch-tool
description: Make HTTP requests via the fetch tool

enabled.description: Whether this extension is enabled. Set to false to disable the extension entirely.

maxBodyLength.description: Maximum number of characters to return before truncating responses.

fetchTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests (headers and body). Slow or dead hosts abort instead of hanging the agent.

allowedSchemes.description: URL schemes the fetch tool may use. Defaults to http/https, which blocks file:// (local file reads) and other schemes.

allowPrivateHosts.description: Allow fetching hosts that are, or resolve to, private/reserved addresses (localhost, RFC1918, link-local/metadata, ULA, CGNAT). Default false blocks SSRF against local/cloud-internal services.
